name: Wayang Slayer (CR 4)
body:
WAYANG SLAYER
CR 4

XP 1,200
Wayang slayer 5
NE Small humanoid (wayang)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+3 armor, +4 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)
hp 47 (5d10+15)
Fort +7, Ref +9, Will +1; +2 vs. shadow spells
Weaknesses one-eyed

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee mwk short sword +9 (1d4+1/19–20), mwk short sword +9 (1d4+1/19–20)
Ranged mwk light crossbow +9 (1d6/19–20)
Special Attacks sneak attack +1d6, studied target +2 (2 targets, move action)

TACTICS

During Combat the npc always uses his studied target ability as a move action to gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls against more dangerous opponents. He also seeks to flank with the npc so he can execute lethal sneak attacks, wielding both short swords with Two-Weapon Fighting and Double Slice.

Morale If reduced to less than 10 hp, the npc drinks his potion of cure moderate wounds and activates his dissolution’s child ability to turn invisible so he can escape.

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 15, Wis 8, Cha 8
Base Atk +5; CMB +5; CMD 19
Feats Dodge, Double Slice, Improved Initiative, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +12 (+8 to jump), Bluff +7, Escape Artist +9, Intimidate +7, Knowledge (geography, local) +10, Perception +7, Stealth +18; Racial Modifiers +2 Perception, +2 Stealth
Languages Abyssal, Common, Tengu, Wayang
SQ dissolution’s child, light and dark, slayer talents (ranger combat style [two-weapon], rogue talent [finesse rogue]), track +2
Gear acid, potion of cure moderate wounds, mwk studded leather, masterwork crossbow with 20 bolts, masterwork short sword (2), cloak of resistance +1, crowbar, two onyxes (each worth 50 gp), 15 gp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dissolution’s Child (Su)

Once per day, the npc may change his appearance to look as if he were little more than a 4-foot-tall area of shadow. His physical form still exists and he is not incorporeal—only his appearance changes. This works like invisibility, except it only lasts 1 round per level (maximum 5 rounds). This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces shadow magic.

One-Eyed (Ex)

the npc lost an eye in a fight with another offworlder he betrayed. This imposes a –2 penalty on his Perception checks and ranged attacks.
